tha-ap415:1.3: ekako → ekato (bj) | ekako abhinikkhamma pabbajiṁ → ekato abhinikkamma pabbajim (pts)
tha-ap415:2.1: caramānonupubbena → caramāno anupubbena (sya-all) | caramānonupubbena gaṅgātīraṁ → caramānānupubbena gaṅgātīram (pts)

tha-ap415:3.2: vasāmi → vasāmi mama (sya-all) | ahaṁ sukato → sukkato (sya-all)
tha-ap415:4.1: mamupenti → mamaṁ upenti (sya-all) | vissatthā kūjanti → sattā kujjanti (sya-all)
tha-ap415:10.4: ophuṭā → otthaṭā (sya-all) | ophuṭā → otthaṭā (bj: syā) | ophuṭā → otthaṭā (cck: syā.)
tha-ap415:15.2: pāṇibhi → pāṇihi (bj) | pāṇibhi tamahaṁ → pāṇihi tam ahaṁ (pts)
tha-ap415:17.3: kammanissandena → kammassa nissando (sya-all) | kammanissandena pupphānaṁ → kammassa nissando pupphāna (pts) | nissando → kammanissandena (bj: machasaṁ) | kammanissandena → kammassa nissando (cck: sī. syā. pī.)

tha-ap415:18.1: sīsaṁnhāto → sīsaṁ nahāto (bj) | sīsaṁnhāto cayaṁ → yaṁ (sya-all)

tha-ap415:18.3: saṁyuttaṁ → saṁyutto (sya-all) | saṁyutto → saṁyuttaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | saṁyuttaṁ → saṁyutto (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
